title: Dynasty Undisturbed: Buducnost Sweep Studentski Centar for an 18th Crown and the Double
description: There is nothing new about Buducnost lifting the Montenegrin championship, and there was nothing new about the manner of it either. The blue-and-white machine closed out the Prva A Liga final by beating Studentski Centar 94-84 on Thursday, completing a clean sweep of the title series and claiming the club's 18th national crown. It was a fitting bookend to a final that was never truly competitive on the scoreboard. Andrej Zakelj's side had crushed Studentski Centar 104-81 in the opener, and the rematch followed a familiar script. Buducnost grabbed control immediately, winning the first quarter 26-17. Studentski Centar punched back to take the second 25-21 and trimmed the gap to 47-42 by halftime, but that was as close as they would get.
